maya: Following up from today's all-hands Q&A on hybrid + offsite ops. Posting concise clarifications and next steps here.

rebecca: Thanks Maya. Quick one: can people bring partners to the welcome dinner?

maya: Managers may approve one guest for the social dinner only. Company covers the event ticket; travel and hotel for guests are on the employee unless pre-approved.

omar: What's the cutoff for hoteling cancellations for SF offices? A teammate was charged a no-show fee.

leah: Cancellation policy: cancel 4 hours before booking start to avoid penalty. For exceptions (flight delays, emergencies) submit facilities@redwood.com within 48 hours and we'll review case-by-case.

rebecca: Any change to the per-diem? The all-hands mentioned $60/day but some folks asked about different city rates.

maya: Per-diem remains $60/day standard. If actual meal costs are higher for specific city events, request a city adjustment via the offsite form; Finance will review for approved exceptions.

omar: Contractors again 10: which expense system?

maya: Contractors should use Expensely unless contract specifies otherwise. Note contractors must mark "Contractor" in profile fields so Finance routes correctly.

ops-bot: Reminder: Final headcount + dietary form closes 2026-07-10 23:59 UTC.

leah: Visa support note: Facilities will submit visa paperwork for covered attendees; we cover standard processing and expedite fees when necessary. Send passport scans to Leah by 2026-07-02.

rebecca: Will there be quiet/work rooms during the offsite for people with deep work needs?

maya: Yes  two focus rooms will be reserved during the offsite window. We'll post booking links in the schedule.

maya: Action items: Leah to publish final travel FAQ and add exceptions section; Omar to update team on cancellation policy; I'll share final schedule and booking links tomorrow. Ping here for any updates.

rebecca: Great, thanks!
